title: Brookfield to fund 49% of up to $30B Intel Arizona fabs

sources.quote: Signs Agreement with Brookfield to Jointly Invest up to $30 Billion in Leading-Edge Chip Factories in Arizona
previously announced manufacturing expansion at its Ocotillo campus in Chandler, Arizona, with Intel funding 51% and Brookfield funding 49% of the total project cost.

explain: Brookfield's infrastructure arm agreed to pay 49% of the cost of Intel's new chip factories in Chandler, Arizona, a project of up to $30 billion. The amount shown is 49% of $30 billion ($14.7 billion), a ceiling.
